name: Solvang Windmill
blurb: A Danish-style windmill on Copenhagen Drive — one of the most photographed spots in Solvang.

name: Old Mission Santa Inés
blurb: A historic California mission from 1804 — church, museum, and gardens just above downtown.

name: Olsen's Danish Village Bakery
blurb: Danish pastries and kringle on Copenhagen Drive — the smell of cinnamon pulls you in from the street.

name: Elverhøj Museum
blurb: Art and history of Solvang's Danish founders — galleries in a house that feels like a storybook.

name: Solvang Festival Theater
blurb: Outdoor plays and concerts under the oaks — a summer tradition in the middle of town.

name: Ingeborg's Danish Chocolates
blurb: Handmade chocolates and gifts on Copenhagen Drive — sweet stop while you walk the Danish streets.
